## User story
As a **Patient**, I want to search doctors by name or specialization and see available times, so that I can choose an appropriate clinician and request an appointment.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Search supports name and/or specialty.
- [ ] Availability is returned for a selected date.
- [ ] Past, unavailable, and already-booked slots are rejected.
